stations.title: Sales list
stations.text: Hundreds of lines, the same items again.

stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: So that is what to print more of.

captions: At Ashgrove, Hesper wants to know what sold best at Saturday's market.
The sales list repeats the same items hundreds of times, too many to count by hand.
You join commands into chains, and change Idris's files safely, in four small tasks.
The chain sorts, counts and ranks the sales, and Idris's files keep every line.
Hesper knows what to print more of, and no file was emptied by mistake.
